acquisition method: For discovery acquisitions, data-dependent acquisition was utilized with an MS1 scan resolution of 120,000
alkylation reagent: mitochondria were treated with either 20 mM DTT for 15 min at 65 °C or 50 mM IAA for 10 min at 30 °C
alkylation concentration: mitochondria were treated with either 20 mM DTT for 15 min at 65 °C or 50 mM IAA for 10 min at 30 °C
cleavage agent: The protein mixtures were reduced, alkylated, and digested by the sequential addition of trypsin and lys-C proteases.
enrichment method: Mitochondrial lysates from Δaim32 strains expressing a C-terminal FLAG-tagged Aim32 ([pAIM32-FLAG], expression controlled from the GPD promoter) or an Vec were purified with FLAG beads
fractionation method: Desalted samples were separated on C18 reversed phase (1.9 μM, 100A pores, Dr Maisch GmbH) columns
instrument: Ionized peptides were interrogated via MS/MS in a Thermo Orbitrap Fusion Lumos.
ionization type: ionized using electrospray ionization by application of a distal 2.2 kV
labeling: Ionized peptides were interrogated via MS/MS in a Thermo Orbitrap Fusion Lumos.
reduction reagent: mitochondria were treated with either 20 mM DTT for 15 min at 65 °C
reduction concentration: mitochondria were treated with either 20 mM DTT for 15 min at 65 °C
